title: Shilbhadra Residence
subtitle: G+2 Contemporary Residence with Pool Deck & Rooftop Lounge
description: A G+2 residence in Kishanganj, Bihar, designed on a narrow 26'-7" wide plot with 1,450 sq.ft. per floor. It features a layered contemporary façade, covered parking beneath the cantilevered upper floors, a second-floor swimming pool behind a terracotta jaali, and a rooftop lounge with circular skylights and solar panels.
body:
Designed for Kumar Shilbhadra in Kishanganj, Bihar, this G+2 residence makes the most of a narrow 26'-7" wide plot, with 1,450 sq.ft. on each floor. The brief was a compact family home that still offers generous outdoor living, from covered parking at ground level to a pool and rooftop lounge above.

The front façade is built up in layers. The upper floors cantilever over the forecourt to shelter two cars, while framed balconies with vertical bars, a concrete-texture panel, mauve accents and a terracotta jaali give the elevation depth and privacy. Along the side, an external timber staircase gives independent access to the upper floor.

The upper levels are where the home opens up. The second floor combines a master suite with dressing, a multipurpose room and a 9' x 14' swimming pool with its own deck, while three skylights bring air and daylight into the floors below. On the roof, a cantilevered canopy with circular skylights shelters a lounge against a stone-clad wall, with solar panels above and planting all around.
features.0.title: A Layered Front Façade
features.0.text: The upper floors cantilever over the forecourt, giving covered parking for two cars at ground level. Above, framed balconies with vertical metal bars, a concrete-texture panel, mauve accent bands and a terracotta jaali screen build up a façade with depth and shadow, finished with a planted parapet and glass railing at roof level.
features.1.title: Planned Floor by Floor
features.1.text: Each floor is planned within a 26'-7" wide footprint. The ground and first floors hold bedrooms, living, dining and kitchen spaces around a shared staircase, with separate entries on the upper floors. The second floor is given over to a master suite with dressing and attached toilet, a multipurpose room, a 9' x 14' swimming pool with a pool deck, a gardening strip and three skylights that bring air and sunlight into the floors below.
features.2.title: A Rooftop Lounge Under the Sky
features.2.text: The roof becomes an outdoor living room. A cantilevered canopy with circular skylight cut-outs and recessed lighting shelters a timber-deck seating area against a stone-clad wall, with planters, a bougainvillea pergola and a frameless glass railing around the terrace. Solar panels on the canopy roof support the home's energy needs.
features.3.title: Side Access & Massing
features.3.text: An external open-riser staircase with timber treads along the side gives independent access to the upper floor, while stacked white, grey and mauve volumes break down the height of the long side elevation.
